heading: Collaboration & Partnership
sub: The examining bodies, accreditation partners, and global platforms PTI works with to keep training current.
seo_title: Collaboration & Partnership — Pioneer Technical Institute, Iganga Uganda
seo_description: Pioneer Technical Institute's partnerships with UBTEB, DIT, Cisco, IBM, and Coursera — bringing globally recognized certification to vocational training in Iganga, Uganda.
seo_keywords: Pioneer Technical Institute partnerships, UBTEB, DIT, Cisco Networking Academy Uganda, IBM SkillsBuild Uganda

sections.heading: Examining & Accrediting Bodies
list: Ministry of Education and Sports — registration as a Private TVET Provider
UBTEB (Uganda Business and Technical Examinations Board) — National Certificate examinations
DIT (Directorate of Industrial Training) — Trade Test examinations and certification

sections.heading: Global Technology Partners
sections.body: To keep ICT training current with what employers actually need, PTI offers pathways aligned with international certification bodies:
list: Cisco Networking Academy — networking and cybersecurity curricula
IBM SkillsBuild — IT support and data analytics foundations
Coursera (Google & Meta Career Certificates) — IT support and mobile/front-end development

sections.heading: Looking to Partner With Us?
sections.body: PTI welcomes partnerships with employers seeking skilled graduates, industry bodies offering attachment placements, and organisations bringing new accreditation or funding opportunities. Contact the Director's office to discuss collaboration.
